scope: INTERIM Qwen3-8B only; remaining model/phase measurements and final audits are pending. Completed offered graph units/s, conditional on the frozen cohort and host. Student t 95% CIs on paired whole-process log throughput ratios; no multiplicity adjustment. Requests within a process are not independent repetitions. Serving seconds exclude startup. Latencies are arithmetic means of process statistics, including process p95s, not pooled request percentiles. Live output lengths, quality, runtimes and interfaces can differ. Throughput is not correctness-adjusted useful work; quality equivalence and universal superiority are not established. Missing external native activity counters are unavailable, not zero.
